card.desc:
# **When equipped gives you:**

**+3 Ability**

**+7 Strength**

**+3 Health**

**Fate’s Spared (**[https://trello.com/c/paFHCpA8/108-rolling-stones](https://trello.com/c/paFHCpA8/108-rolling-stones "smartCard-inline") **picks you half as often.)**

**Crimson Hunter (For 10 seconds after a** [https://trello.com/c/4CpREEmM/395-king-crimson-full](https://trello.com/c/4CpREEmM/395-king-crimson-full "smartCard-inline") **user uses Time Skip, Time Erase or Epitaph, you deal them more damage by 20%)**

**Surehit (After you land 10 hits, your next hit can’t be dodged by Epitaph.)**

## **Obtained from:** [https://trello.com/c/W2k56kIE/785-the-statue-of-sorrow](https://trello.com/c/W2k56kIE/785-the-statue-of-sorrow "smartCard-inline") (If Rolling Stones lured)
card.name: Hand Of Fate
